rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
compound with internal sandhi: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulaṃ (root Kaula)

items.question: What additional attainment constitutes the root Kaula for the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The verse enumerates eight items in continuation of prior attainments.
The attainment of powers is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The eightfold attainment of powers is declared to be the foundational Kaula realization.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight attainments depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: And the eightfold attainment of powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
